cases.input: Evaluate representative application evidence against a prior assessment spec and return a promotion recommendation without mutating learning state.
requiredBehaviors: leave durable state mutation to learning-state
forbiddenBehaviors: promote beyond the observed assessment level
skillAnchors: Die Bewertung darf nie höher sein als das tatsächlich beobachtete Evidenzniveau

cases.input: An ETF exam has a high overall score but includes one critical conceptual error and too few independent observations for the target competency.
requiredBehaviors: treat evidence breadth separately from overall score
return insufficient evidence when the spec is not sufficiently covered
forbiddenBehaviors: convert the high percentage directly into transfer competence
hide the critical error inside an average
skillAnchors: Ein kritischer Fehler kann einen ansonsten hohen Gesamtscore entwerten

cases.input: There is no prior assessment spec, evidence references are missing, and a reviewer wants to invent a pass threshold after seeing the result.
requiredBehaviors: mark the evidence as not durably promotable
request a valid assessment spec and stable evidence references
